explanation: The statement matches Conjecture 4.4 of arXiv 2501.03234v1: for n in N, S(k) > nk for all sufficiently large primes k depending on n. `∀ᶠ k` with the implication to primes is the right encoding, and 'odd' is automatic for large k. The file's numbering is that of arXiv v1 (its test docstring cites v1), but its reference link is unversioned and resolves to v3 (Jan 2026), which renumbers these conjectures. Pinning the reference to v1 would avoid confusion. The formal statement is unaffected. Note also that v3 replaces this by a differently worded Conjecture 3.3 about growth rate, so the v1 form is what is formalized here.
